races.paceDynamic: Style Of Life, Montezin, and Highland Olly will ensure a strong early gallop over this 7f trip at York. With 9 runners wanting prominent positions behind these leaders, the pace will be sustained throughout with serious traffic problems developing from the 3f marker. The combination of genuine pace pressure and congestion in behind creates a tactical setup that strongly favours hold-up horses who can find clear runs late. This race shape decisively benefits the patient, hold-up brigade.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Heroes Prevail
scenarios.trigger: If the pace leaders maintain strong fractions and the prominent pack gets shuffled
scenarios.body: The genuine gallop will find out the prominent runners while hold-up horses get perfect tow into the race. Late runners with class like Spirit Genie and Leadman can unleash finishing kicks when others have shot their bolt.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Position Perfect
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners secures ideal position just behind the pace
scenarios.body: They avoid the early burn-up while getting first run on the tiring leaders and fading hold-up horses. Zarathos or Harry The Rogue could time their move perfectly from this tactical spot.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the three leaders go too fast early and come back dramatically
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the 2f pole with prominent runners having positional advantage. Moon Beginnings and Captain Parma could capitalize on the reduced pace demands.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Highland Olly or Style Of Life can dictate more sensible fractions
scenarios.body: One of the pace-setters could steal a march when the field expects them to fold. Highland Olly's recent winning form makes him the most likely to pull off this surprise.

scenarios.label: A

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Altareq Wire-to-Wire Shock
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners completely neutralize each other through aggressive early positioning battles.
scenarios.body: With 364 days off, Altareq gets such an easy uncontested lead that the field can never close the gap despite his modest ability. The prominent traffic jam is so severe that by the time they sort themselves out, Altareq has stolen an unassailable advantage.

scenarios.label: D

scenarios.trigger: If a horse positioned in the middle division avoids both the early pace mess and gets first run on the leaders.
scenarios.body: A tactically-placed runner like Castle Stuart or Per Contra finds the perfect trip tracking the pace from an untroubled position. They strike before the hold-up horses can organize their challenge and stay clear of the prominent group's problems.
